Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production whole-body CEL ANIMATION sheet for Utsu's dual-sword dance, FOUR chronological complete character drawings, arranged 2 columns x 2 rows on a SQUARE 2048x2048-style canvas with actual transparent alpha.

This is the first TWO contacts of a cumulative 2→3→4→5-hit acrobatic sword dance. Torso, pelvis, shoulders, elbows and knees move together with rotational force. Feet and hips must show the actual step and weight transfer, not just arms waving.
TOP LEFT (1 COIL): low right-facing three-quarter stance, lead knee bent and rear heel lifting for a short gliding step. Shoulders coiled away from the rightward target, lead sword pulled back beside the shoulder with its blade angled to upper LEFT, rear sword low beside rear hip with blade pointing lower LEFT. Both grips visibly readable. Face watches RIGHT.
TOP RIGHT (2 FIRST CONTACT): fluid short forward lunge to RIGHT. Front knee bent, rear leg extending to drive pelvis and shoulders forward. The lead hand sweeps its sword broadly toward SCREEN RIGHT at lower CHEST height, blade almost horizontal and fully visible to right. Other hand counterbalances behind left hip with its sword low LEFT. Torso rotated forward, same rightward gaze, clean readable anatomy.
BOTTOM LEFT (3 CONNECTING FOLLOW-THROUGH): continue the FIRST sword's same cutting direction: lead hand passes slightly down and across the front so its blade points DOWN-RIGHT, lead elbow relaxed after extension. The other gripping hand has drawn its sword backward beside the rear hip pointing LEFT, winding up an ascending return cut. Weight settles through both bent knees, shoulders and pelvis coil the opposite way. This pose is the visible bridge, not a return to idle.
BOTTOM RIGHT (4 SECOND CONTACT / RISING RETURN): the opposite hand now makes the second ascending diagonal slash from low LEFT toward upper RIGHT at shoulder level. Active sword is extended diagonally up-right in a firm ordinary grip; the first sword stays low-right clear of the body. Hips rise through the front leg, rear heel lifts, torso twists into a lively three-quarter front stance. This rising momentum should be able to continue into a turn and a leap. Feet remain near ground here, not yet airborne.
All FOUR entire bodies plus BOTH entire swords in EACH drawing isolated with wide clear transparent gutters and outer margins. Place each figure at same anatomical scale; do not enlarge the crouch to fill its cell. No overlap or clipped blade/boot/cape tips. Full-body painted anime game sprite quality, precise clean linework and restrained painterly cel shading matching reference. No scene, floor, shadows, text, panel lines, ghost images, slash streaks, aura, glow or motion blur. True transparent background. Do not draw an extra sword or missing second sword.
